simple.meaning: לָהַט (lâhaṭ) is a Hebrew word meaning “properly, to lick , i.e. (by implication) to blaze.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: לָהַט (H3857) appears 11 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 32:22, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, Joel, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לָהַט (H3857) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לָהַט (H3857) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לָהַט (lâhaṭ) / H3857 is traced through Deuteronomy 32:22, Job 41:13, Psalms 57:5, Psalms 83:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3857. lahat [ לָהַט ] verb blaze up, flame (Late Hebrew id. ; Syriac ; Assyrian la±âtu , in derived forms); — Qal Participle active לֹהֵט אֵשׁ Psa 104:4 a flaming fire (so Bae; וָלַהַט אֵשׁ Bi Che, compare Ol), made into ׳י s servants; plural לֹהֲטִים 57:5 (figurative of enemies, compare לְבָאִם v a ). Pi`el Perfect 3feminine singular וְלִהַט Malachi 3:19; 3 feminine singular לִהֲטָה Joel 1:19 ; Imperfect 3feminine singular תְּלַהֵט 2:3-4 t.; וַתְּלַהֵט Deut 32:22 ; suffix וַתְּלַהֲטֵהוּ Isa 42:25 ; — set ablaze , usually with accusative; — foundation of mountains, Deut 32:22 (subject אֵשׁ figurative, of ׳י s judgement, || אָכַל יָקַד, קָדַח, ), compare ׳תְּל הָרִים Psa 83:15 (in simile, subject לֶהָבָה ; || תִּבְעַריָֿ֑עַר כְּאֵשׁ ; of flame ( לֶהָבָה ); consuming trees Joel 1:19 ( of effects of drought; || אָֽכְלָה אֵשׁ ); persons Malachi 3:19 (subject הַבָּא הַיּוֺם || בָּעַר ); compare Psa 97:3 (subject אֵשׁ ), 106:18 (subject לֶהָבָה || אֵשׁ וַתִּבְעַרֿ ; hyperb of ׳י s wrath ( חֵמָה מִלְחָמָה וֱעֶזוּז אַמּוֺ ) consuming Jacob Isa 42:25 ; of crocodile (hyperb.), תְלַהֵ֑ט גֶּחָלִים נַפְשׁוֺ Job 41:13 his breath setteth coals ablaze ; absolute Joel 2:3 , figurative of devastation by locusts (subject לֶהָבָה ; || אֵשׁ אָֽכְלָה ).
